sources.title: GitHub - mcrao/legal-slm-125M
sources.snippet: Two models, two behaviors. The base model continues text; it does not answer questions. The fine-tuned model (Phase 8) answers questions but, at 125M parameters, still fabricates case names, citations, and figures. Never use either model's output as legal, financial, or factual advice.

sources.title: slm125m — a 125M legal & financial language model, trained from scratch
sources.snippet: A 125.8M-parameter legal & financial language model, built from scratch for $31.76 and RAFT fine-tuned to refuse when the answer isn't in the context.

sources.title: legal-slm-125 · a 125M legal & financial language model
sources.snippet: Fine-tuned on 5,846 grounded legal & financial Q&A pairs, the same 125M model stops rambling and starts answering. It is a separate model, legal-slm-125m-sft ↗, that streams its reply as you watch.

sources.title: slm-125m — a 125.8M-parameter model trained from scratch
sources.snippet: A 125.8M-parameter LLaMA-architecture language model trained from scratch on US case law, SEC filings, and the open web. Live inference demo, full architecture and training specs.
